_meta.description: Curated key verses from 1 Chronicles (seek the Lord and his strength, give thanks for he is good, David's doxology). Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 13 1 Chronicles); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: key verses from the substantive chapters; genealogy/register chapters omitted
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.

verses.text: Seek the Lord and his strength, seek his face continually.
verses.plain: Seek the Lord and his strength; seek his face continually.

verses.text: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.plain: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his love endures forever.

verses.text: Thine, O Lord, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O Lord, and thou art exalted as head above all.
verses.plain: Yours, Lord, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the victory and the majesty; for everything in heaven and earth is yours. Yours, Lord, is the kingdom; you are exalted as head over all.
